subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this sidebar-only iPhone root navigation and retain the expanded native Overview/dashboard despite the related web direction retiring its Overview page?
rationale: The patch is a large intentional UX and information-architecture replacement, not a narrow bug repair; the protected label and related web decision do not establish that iOS should make the same tradeoff.

options.title: Sponsor the iOS sidebar direction
options.body: Approve the sidebar-only root shell and native Overview/dashboard, contingent on a refreshed current-head simulator run covering saved-session and multi-agent flows.

options.title: Align iOS with the web retirement
options.body: Keep the sidebar work but remove or narrow the native Overview/dashboard so attention and session summaries live in their owning destinations.

options.title: Pause for a narrower navigation proposal
options.body: Defer the full replacement and split a smaller, explicitly approved iPhone navigation change from the dashboard expansion.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the iOS sidebar direction
recommendation.body: Approve the sidebar-only root shell and native Overview/dashboard, contingent on a refreshed current-head simulator run covering saved-session and multi-agent flows.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR and the related navigation-direction issue tie this person directly to the active iOS and preceding web product direction.
